hero.title: Online auctions
hero.description: Create your club, firefighter company, small business or family auction in minutes. Real-time bidding, Chilean pesos, no fees. Payment and delivery are arranged in person, as always.

features.sectionDescription: No spreadsheets, no chaotic chat groups, no fees. Just your auction working.

realTimeBidding.title: Real-time bidding
realTimeBidding.description: Bids appear instantly for every participant, no page reloads.

privateSecure.title: Private or open
privateSecure.description: Invite-only, link access or fully open. You decide who joins, with roles and anonymous bidding if you like.

multiCurrency.title: Chilean pesos first
multiCurrency.description: Amounts in $ CLP with no odd decimals, on Chile time. Other currencies supported too.

smartNotifications.title: Notifications that arrive
smartNotifications.description: In-app bell and Spanish emails: outbid alerts, wins, new lots and comments.

richMedia.title: Lots with photos
richMedia.description: Upload images per item, import via CSV or bulk-edit. Your auctions look professional.

offlineExchange.title: Offline payment, tracked
offlineExchange.description: No gateways, no fees: payment and delivery happen in person, and the platform tracks each state.

useCases.sectionDescription: Wherever a community raises funds, Biddu fits right in.

charity.title: Firefighters & causes
charity.description: Benefit auctions for your company or cause: publish donated lots, collect bids and award to the highest bidder.

declutter.title: Small business & clearance
declutter.description: Clear stock or equipment with tidy auctions: photos, starting bids, increments and exportable results.

family.title: Sports clubs
family.description: Fund your club with auctions among members and fans: jerseys, prizes and experiences in one place.

office.title: Family & friends
office.description: The weekend auction, the class raffle or the garage sale: invite by email and let the best bid win.

howItWorks.sectionDescription: No manuals, no courses. This simple:

step1.title: Create your auction
step1.description: Name it, describe it and choose who can join: invite-only, link or open.

step2.title: Upload the lots
step2.description: Add items with photos, starting bid and minimum increment. Or import them all via CSV.

step3.title: Invite bidders
step3.description: Send email invites. If someone has no account, they register and land straight in your auction.

step4.title: Watch live bidding
step4.description: Every bid shows instantly and everyone gets notified. At closing, the highest bidder wins.

step5.title: Settle payment & delivery
step5.description: The app shows you the winner's contact and tracks the record: pending, paid and delivered.

impact.sectionDescription: Every auction moves real resources for real communities.

items.a: Yes. Biddu is 100% free and open source under the MIT license. No fees, no limits: self-host it on your own server.

Payment is 100% offline: the winner settles directly with the item owner (transfer, cash, whatever they agree). The platform processes no payments and charges no fees; it only tracks the record: pending, paid and delivered.

items.q: Do I need a RUT to register?
items.a: No, RUT is optional. You only need a name, email and password. You can add it to your profile for formal auctions.
Chilean pesos ($ CLP) by default, no decimals, on Chile time. You can also create auctions in other currencies.

items.q: Can I run Biddu on my own server?
items.a: Yes, it is Docker self-hostable under the MIT license. Clone the repo and run docker compose up.
Your data is only visible to members of your auctions. You can export it or delete your account (with all your data) anytime. See the Privacy Policy for details.

cta.title: Start your first auction today
cta.description: Free, in Spanish and with no fees. Your community will thank you.
cta.selfHostDescription: Biddu is open source and Docker self-hostable. Full control of your data on your own infrastructure.
